name: micrograd-autograd-from-scratch
primer:
Provided for you (already defined in your namespace at grade time — use it, do NOT redefine):

  class Value: a scalar node in the autograd graph. Construct with
      Value(data, _children=(), _op="").
    Attributes:
      .data       float — the scalar value
      .grad       float — the accumulated dL/d(self); starts at 0.0
      ._prev      set of the parent Value nodes this one was built from
      ._op        short str label (e.g. "+", "*", "tanh"); for debugging
      ._backward  a zero-arg closure. Each op you write sets it to ADD (+=) this
                  node's local gradient into each input's .grad, scaled by out.grad.

Pattern for an op: out = Value(result, (inputs...), "op"); define a local _backward()
that pushes gradient to the inputs; set out._backward = _backward; return out.
backward(root) seeds root.grad = 1.0 and runs every _backward in reverse topological order.
Every other function in this project is also available in your namespace at grade
time — call earlier steps by name; you do not import them. Run
`uv run python projects.py micrograd-autograd-from-scratch` (or the outline drawer) to see all signatures.
title: Build Your Own Autograd Engine (micrograd)

parts.title: Scalar Arithmetic
parts.description: Implement add, multiply, power, and subtract on Value nodes, each wiring up its local backward closure.

parts.title: Activations
parts.description: Implement ReLU, tanh, and exp on Value nodes with their local gradients.

parts.title: Reverse-Mode Autodiff
parts.description: Topologically sort the graph and run reverse-mode backprop from a scalar output.

parts.title: Neural Network
parts.description: Build neurons, layers, and an MLP out of Value nodes.

parts.title: Training
parts.description: Collect parameters, an MSE loss, zero_grad, an SGD step, and the training loop.

steps.name: v_add
steps.doc: Return a Value holding the sum of a and b, propagating gradient to both addends.

steps.name: v_mul
steps.doc: Return a Value holding the product of a and b, with the product-rule gradient.

steps.name: v_pow
steps.doc: Return a Value holding a raised to the constant power n, with the power-rule gradient.

steps.name: v_sub
steps.doc: Return a Value holding the difference a minus b, propagating gradient with opposite signs.

steps.name: v_relu
steps.doc: Apply the rectified linear unit (clamp negatives to zero) to a Value.

steps.name: v_tanh
steps.doc: Apply the hyperbolic tangent activation to a Value.

steps.name: v_exp
steps.doc: Apply the natural exponential to a Value.

steps.name: build_topo
steps.doc: Return the nodes of root's graph in depth-first postorder (children before parents, root last).

steps.name: backward
steps.doc: Seed root's grad to 1.0 and run each node's _backward in reverse topological order.

steps.name: init_neuron
steps.doc:
Create a neuron as a dict of nin random weights in [-1,1] and a zero bias.

Return {"w": <list of nin weight Values>, "b": <bias Value with data 0.0>}. Build weights with rng = random.Random(seed), then Value(rng.uniform(-1, 1)) for each of the nin weights in draw order, so the seeded sequence matches exactly.

steps.name: neuron_forward
steps.doc:
Compute tanh of the weighted sum of inputs x plus the neuron's bias.

neuron["w"] is the list of weight Values and neuron["b"] is the bias Value; return tanh(neuron["b"] + sum(w_i * x_i)) pairing neuron["w"] with x in order (build the sum with v_mul/v_add and apply v_tanh).

steps.name: layer_forward
steps.doc: Apply every neuron in the layer to the same input list x, returning their outputs.

steps.name: mlp_forward
steps.doc: Thread the input list x through each layer in turn and return the last layer's outputs.

steps.name: parameters
steps.doc:
Return a flat list of all weight and bias Values across every neuron in every layer.

mlp is a list of layers, each a list of neuron dicts ("w": list of weight Values, "b": bias Value). Return the same Value objects (not copies), ordered per layer, then per neuron, emitting all of neuron["w"] in order followed by neuron["b"].

steps.name: mse_loss
steps.doc: Return the summed squared-error Value between predictions and target floats.

steps.name: zero_grad
steps.doc: Reset the .grad of every parameter Value to 0.0.

steps.name: sgd_step
steps.doc: Update each parameter's data in place by a gradient-descent step of size lr.

steps.name: train
steps.doc:
Run n_steps of full-batch SGD on the MLP and return the list of per-step loss floats.

X is a list of input vectors (each a list of floats); Y a list of target floats (single-output MLP). Each step: zero_grad(parameters(mlp)); for every input, WRAP its floats as [Value(xi) for xi in x] (mlp_forward operates on Value nodes, not raw floats) and take mlp_forward(mlp, xv)[0] as the scalar prediction; mse_loss over all predictions vs Y; backward; sgd_step. Return the list of per-step loss floats (loss.data), which should decrease.
